description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base FilterParams class to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching employee dependents, including properties like name, employee number, and relationship type, with relevant getter and setter methods. It also initializes a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for employee dependent search filters, including properties for name, employee number, and relationship type, with default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with a default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type filter value.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type filter value.
